rows.author: I066
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING TITLE IV, CHAPTER 1, ARTICLES 74, 75, 76 AND 77 OF RA 8533
rows.abstract:
Proposes several amendments among others to Executive Order No. 209, the Family Code of the Phils. regarding property relations between husband and wife:
Sec.74 is amended to read as follows:
“”¦ (4) by the execution of a contract modifying the default or marriage settlement elected before the marriage.”
Sec. 75 is amended to read as follows:
“”¦ In the absence of marriage settlement, or when the regime agreed upon is void, the system of conjugal partnership of gains shall govern”¦”
Sec. 76, is amended to read as follows:
“In order that any modification in the marriage settlements may be valid, it must be made in writing and duly subscribed to the local civil registrar where the marriage is recorded ”¦ The modification of marriage settlement shall apply prospectively."
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2019-08-28
